synthesis.boundary_terminology: For finite volume, boundary-at-infinity data are ideal vertices/cusps.  A faithful surface encoding uses resolved exceptional boundary clusters and their dual-complex incidence, not one point carrying all cusp-wall curves.

general_compiler_support.interpretation: The determinant/Heegner and cusp rows test the general decorated compiler.  The Coble and toric inverse rows test stronger native divisor-surface realization, but only in scoped or individual carrier lanes.  They do not prove that a general arithmetic chamber has a native nef-cone surface.

single_missing_classification_invariant.definition: the least marked projective degree/stratum-degree package of a faithful decorated surface carrier, including all ordinary face strata, the exceptional boundary clusters and their dual complexes at every cusp, the sheet-separating level, and the marked Heegner curves

single_missing_classification_invariant.why_it_matters: a P-computable bound in terms of n, [k:Q], discriminant, lattice level, and facet count would place every carrier in finitely many explicit Hilbert/Hurwitz stacks, making surface classification capable of pushing a theorem back to P
